name: Yuzuki Kanade
source:
She is sick and often misses classes.
She speaks less and tends to avoid communicating with others.
When she takes off her eyepatch, she is rumored to be a beautiful girl.
She was a little snippy, and the response to her protagonist who helped her stumbling in her hallway was simply unpleasant.

"Thank you...I didn't ask."
